message.content:
**Order filled:** Buy 27 shares of COST at a limit of $905.00 (filled at $905.00) — total $24,435.

**Summary:** I read Costco's fiscal 2024 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended 2024-09-01) and checked the live quote, which showed COST at $904.13 (bid $904.11 / ask $904.15) as of 15:05 UTC on 2024-11-06. The fundamentals support a buy: total net sales grew to $254,453M from $242,290M in fiscal 2023 (+5.0%), operating income rose to $9,285M from $8,114M (+14.4%), net income rose to $7,367M from $6,292M (+17.1%), diluted EPS rose to $16.56 from $14.16 (+17.0%), and operating cash flow was a healthy $11,339M — a consistent picture of steady top-line growth with faster margin and earnings expansion, and no red flags in the filing (routine legal proceedings, effective disclosure controls, adequate liquidity). At $904.13 the stock trades at roughly 54.6x fiscal 2024 diluted EPS, which is a rich multiple, so I sized the position conservatively rather than aggressively. I placed a single buy limit order for 27 shares at $905.00 — about 0.1% above the market, satisfying the "close to current market price" requirement — for a notional of $24,435, which is under the $25,000 per-order cap and, as the only trade today, well under the $50,000 daily cap; the order was funded entirely from existing cash ($50,000 available), so no money left the account, and it complies with the COST/GOOGL, buy-only mandate.
